import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long oo = 1000000000L;
    static long n;
    static long[] a = new long[18];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();

        a[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 18; i++) {
            a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }

        System.out.println(f(n, 17));
        sc.close();
    }

    static long f(long m, int ind) {
        long tmp = (m / a[ind]) * (ind + 1);
        m %= a[ind];
        if (m == 0)
            return tmp;
        return tmp + Math.min(ind + 1 + f(a[ind] - m, ind - 1), f(m, ind - 1));
    }
}
